Compute r power curve

Source: R/GLM_CORRELATION.R
compute_power_r.Rd

Compute r power curve

Usage

compute_power_r(
  n = 100,
  r = NULL,
  sig.level = 0.05,
  alternative = c("two.sided", "less", "greater"),
  title = "",
  base_size = 10
)

Arguments

n

number of observations

r

correlation coefficient

sig.level

alpha (type I error probability)

alternative

a character string specifying the alternative hypothesis, which must be one of "two.sided" (default), "greater" or "less"

title

plot title

base_size

base font size

Examples

compute_power_r(n=100,r=.5,sig.level=.05,alternative=c("two.sided"))
